claim: Indian legal analysis published August 4 outlines three power procurement routes for data centres in India under the Electricity Act 2003, including captive power generation (Section 9) and open access, showing open access rates of ₹3.50–5.00/unit versus ₹8–11/unit commercial DISCOM tariffs.

Microsoft launched its India South Central datacenter region in Hyderabad on August 6, disclosing over 1000 MW of multi-year Corporate Power Purchase Agreements for renewable energy specifically in India.
quote_fragment: In India, Microsoft has so far entered into multiple multi-year Corporate Power Purchase Agreements
